about: FP-295 eval: 24 real dispatcher questions (18 from the spec, 6 added by analysis A1 for the kinds of answer the model used to work out itself) for the Analytics chat. Run with backend/scripts/eval_analytics_chat.py; never in CI (it calls the real model). Presets are resolved on the day the eval runs, exactly as the page resolves them. page_shows and must_mention are read from /analytics BEFORE the model is run (spec §8.5), for the organisation and date in recorded_for.

recorded_for.how: q01–q18 read in the browser from /analytics on 19 Oct and re-checked on 20 Oct from each tab's own service function (proven equal to the page by the integration tests); q19–q24 added on 20 Oct, expected figures worked out by hand from the tabs' raw rows (not from the totals block, so the leaders don't grade themselves). Changes since 19 Oct: a 5th cancellation (FP-20261016-0F83C263, cancelled 20 Oct 12:52 SAST) and the oldest critical is now 5 days old.

questions.page: On time → On-time departures and arrivals (arrivals)
questions.page_shows: Arrivals on time: Jul 2026 1 of 1 (100%); Oct 2026 (in progress) 1 of 2 (50%); no planned trips in other months. Departures 0 of 3 on time.

questions.question: What share of arrivals were on time in the last 12 weeks?
questions.page: On time → On-time departures and arrivals (sum of on-time ÷ with a plan)
questions.page_shows: 1 of 2 arrivals on time (50%): 28 Sep–4 Oct 1 of 1, 12–18 Oct 0 of 1.
